cities.name: Helsinki
interests: Seaside Walks 🌊 — Harbors, islands and Baltic breezes along the waterfront.
Modern Nordic Architecture 🏛️ — Light-filled libraries, clean lines and innovative design.
Parks & Nature 🌿 — Urban parks, viewpoints and green waterfront spaces.
Local Food Exploration 😋 — Soups, rye bread, cinnamon buns and berry desserts.
Art & Design 🎨 — Design District corners, galleries and architecture highlights.
Urban Culture 🎭 — Squares, markets, cozy cafés and relaxed city life.
cities.local_food_tip: Warm Nordic dishes like vegetable soups, hearty stews, rye bread sandwiches, cinnamon pastries and berry-based desserts — simple, natural and very comforting after a seaside walk.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Start by the harbor at Kauppatori (Market Square): calm seaside views, small stalls and ferries coming and going. → ⛪ Walk up to Helsingin tuomiokirkko (Helsinki Cathedral) overlooking Senaatintori (Senate Square). → ☕ Take a break in a cozy Nordic café in the nearby streets for coffee and a cinnamon bun. Afternoon: 🎨 Head towards Design District Helsinki: design shops, local brands and creative windows. → 🌿 Stroll through Esplanadin puisto (Esplanadi Park) with benches and trees between two elegant streets. → 🏛️ Continue to Keskustakirjasto Oodi (Helsinki Central Library Oodi): a modern wooden-glass landmark, even just from the outside. → 🍽️ Lunch with soups, rye bread and veggie stews in the city center. Sunset: 🌅 Climb or walk up to Tähtitorninvuoren puisto (Observatory Hill Park) for a soft sunset view over rooftops and the harbor. Night: 🌃 Return via Kauppatori (Market Square) and illuminated harbor; grab dessert or hot chocolate in nearby cafés and enjoy city lights reflecting on the water.

ideas: 🌸 Cherry blossoms in Roihuvuoren kirsikkapuisto (Roihuvuori Cherry Park) creating a pink tunnel.
🚶 Light jacket walks through Esplanadin puisto (Esplanadi Park) and harbor streets.
☕ Terrace cafés slowly opening with blankets and heaters.
🌱 First green leaves in small parks and waterfront paths.
🌊 Long seaside strolls along the harbor, Kaivopuisto and small piers.
🍓 Fresh berry stands at Kauppatori (Market Square).
🌇 Late sunsets with orange-pink skies over the city and sea.
🚤 Short island ferry rides from the market area for extra sea views.
🍁 Park foliage turning gold and red in Kaivopuisto (Kaivopuisto Park) and Esplanadi.
🥧 Cozy bakeries serving cinnamon buns and cardamom pastries.
🎨 Museum and design shop afternoons around the Design District.
🌫 Windy yet beautiful walks along the waterfront with scarves and hot drinks.
🎄 Christmas Market at Senaatintori (Senate Square Christmas Market).
🍫 Hot chocolate and coffee in warm cafés with big windows.
✨ Light installations and decorations in the center and Esplanadi.
❄ Snowy harbor views and crisp, cold air by the sea.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 The metro connects central Helsinki with eastern and western coastal districts quickly.
🚌 Buses fill in the gaps, reaching residential areas and viewpoints not served by metro.
🚊 Trams are perfect for slow city sightseeing through popular neighborhoods.
🚲 City bikes are easy to rent and great for waterfront paths in warmer months.
📱 Use the 'HSL' app for route planning, tickets and real-time departures across all transport.

city_events.name: Helsinki Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 A city-wide arts festival bringing music, theatre, dance and visual arts to parks, streets and venues.

city_events.name: Lux Helsinki
city_events.description: ✨ Light art festival illuminating buildings and public spaces in the darkest time of year.

city_events.name: Helsinki Design Week
city_events.description: 🎨 Events, exhibitions and open studios focusing on Finnish design and creativity.

cities.name: Espoo
interests: Nature 🌿 — Forests, rocky landscapes and national park trails.
Lakes 🌊 — Quiet lakeshores, reflections and wooden piers.
Modern Architecture 🏛️ — Museums and modern residential centers.
cities.local_food_tip: Light Nordic meals like vegetable soups, roasted veggie dishes, fresh salads, pastries and berry sweets — perfect after a hike or lakeside walk.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌿 Head to Nuuksion kansallispuisto (Nuuksio National Park): forest trails, lakes and rocky viewpoints. Choose an easy loop trail and enjoy the quiet. → ☕ Forest café or picnic break with thermos tea if available. Afternoon: 🏛️ Return towards the city and stop near EMMA – Espoon modernin taiteen museo (Espoo Museum of Modern Art) (Exterior area) in Tapiola. → 🌊 Take a gentle walk around Tapiolan keskusta (Tapiola Center) and its lakeside pools and gardens. → 🍽️ Lunch with soups and salads in the Tapiola or Leppävaara area. Sunset: 🌅 Enjoy lakeshore reflections at Otaniemen ranta (Otaniemi Lakeside) or another nearby waterfront spot. Night: 🌃 Quiet modern-center lights, calm streets and a warm café if you’re still around Tapiola or Espoon keskus.

ideas: 🌸 Forest flowers and fresh moss in Nuuksio National Park.
🚶 Short park trails near Tapiola and Otaniemi.
☕ Outdoor cafés with views of water and modern buildings.
🕊 Birds returning to quiet lakes.
🌊 Swimming piers around Espoo’s lakes and sea inlets.
🍦 Ice cream stops at local kiosks after walks.
🌇 Long evenings sitting by the waterfront in Otaniemi or Haukilahti.
🚣 Gentle boating, SUP or just watching people on the water.
🍁 Golden trees in Nuuksio and suburban forests.
🥧 Pastry cafés in Tapiola on cooler days.
🎨 Museum visits at EMMA and nearby cultural centers.
🌫 Misty lakes and quiet pine-scented paths.
❄️ Snowy forest paths in Nuuksio with crunchy footsteps.
🍫 Hot drinks after short, cold walks.
✨ Evening lights in modern centers like Tapiola.
🧊 Frozen lakes creating a serene white landscape (safety first – only walk on ice where officially allowed).

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Commuter trains from Helsinki connect quickly to major Espoo hubs like Leppävaara and Espoon keskus.
🚌 Buses and metro lines reach Tapiola, Matinkylä and other neighborhoods.
🚇 The metro from Helsinki goes into southern Espoo, useful for coastal areas.
📱 Use the 'HSL' app for journey planning, real-time updates and all ticket types.

city_events.name: Espoo Ciné
city_events.description: 🎬 Film festival with screenings, including outdoor showings in a relaxed atmosphere.

city_events.name: Espoo Päivät (Espoo Days)
city_events.description: 🎭 City celebration with local culture, performances and family activities.

cities.name: Oulu
interests: Seaside 🌊 — Gulf of Bothnia coastline and harbor views.
Parks & Nature 🌿 — Island parks, rivers and green spaces.
Urban Culture 🎭 — Lively squares, quirky events and studenty vibe.
cities.local_food_tip: Nordic-style vegetable soups, fresh salads, berry pastries and warm, veggie-friendly plates are easy to find and perfect for a windy coastal city.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Walk along the Oulun kauppatori (Oulu Market Square) and harbor area. → 📸 See the famous Toripolliisi-patsas (Toripolliisi Statue). → ☕ Have breakfast or a snack in a market café near the water. Afternoon: 🌿 Head into Hupisaarten kaupunginpuisto (Hupisaaret Islands City Park) with bridges, streams and green islands. → 🍽️ Light lunch in the city center. → 🏞️ Follow paths along Oulujoki (Oulu River). Sunset: 🌅 Take a trip to Nallikarin ranta (Nallikari Beach) for wide sea views and a big sky sunset. Night: 🌃 Return to the harbor and center for dessert and soft harbor lights.

ideas: 🌸 Park blooms appearing in Hupisaaret.
🚶 Seaside walks as the snow melts along the Gulf of Bothnia.
☕ Terrace seating in central cafés when the sun gets stronger.
🕊 Migrating birds around the river mouth.
🌊 Beach time and boardwalk strolls at Nallikari.
🍦 Ice cream near the market square and harbor.
🌇 Very late sunsets, with long golden hours.
🎶 Occasional outdoor events and performances in the center.
🍁 Tree colors along Oulujoki and city parks.
🥧 Warm café stops when coastal wind picks up.
🎨 Visits to local galleries and cultural centers.
🌫 Foggy mornings by the river and sea.
❄️ Snowy seaside walks near Nallikari with a very Arctic feel.
🍫 Hot cocoa in cozy cafés to warm up.
✨ Frosty trees in Hupisaaret and riverside paths.
🌌 Clear nights sometimes showing bright stars.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Oulu has a good bus system connecting the center, Nallikari, university and suburbs.
🚲 The city is bike-friendly, with many paths usable in summer and often even in winter.
🚆 Trains and long-distance buses make Oulu a convenient northern hub.
📱 Use Oulu region transport information (e.g. 'Oulun joukkoliikenne') online for maps and timetables.

city_events.name: Air Guitar World Championships
city_events.description: 🎸 A fun and quirky world-famous event where competitors perform air guitar on stage.

city_events.name: Oulu August Festivals
city_events.description: 🎭 A cluster of cultural events, music and performances across the city.

cities.name: Rovaniemi
interests: Arctic Nature 🌿 — Forests, fells and rivers in Lapland’s capital.
Snow & Winter Magic ❄️ — Deep winter, lights, and festive atmospheres.
Riverside Walks 🌊 — Peaceful views along the Kemijoki river.
Scenic Viewpoints 🌅 — Hills and bridges overlooking Arctic landscapes.
Local Food Exploration 😋 — Warm soups, breads and berry desserts for cold days.
cities.local_food_tip: Focus on hearty yet simple Nordic options: vegetable soups, warm stews, rye bread, oven-baked dishes and berry desserts — perfect after walking in cold, fresh Arctic air.
cities.full_day: Morning: ❄️ Visit the Napapiiri (Arctic Circle area) near Joulupukin Pajakylä (Santa Claus Village) from the outside: Arctic Circle line, snow scenes in winter and forest surroundings. → 🌊 Return toward town and walk along Kemijoki (Kemijoki River) for bright snow or calm summer reflections. → ☕ Cozy Nordic café stop in the center for a hot drink. Afternoon: 🌿 See the exterior and park area around Arktikum (Arctic Science Centre and Museum) by the river. → 🍽️ Warm soup and bread lunch in town. → 🏞️ Head towards Ounasvaara for forest paths, viewpoints and hilltop scenery. Sunset: 🌅 Enjoy Arctic sunset glow from Ounasvaara or a high riverside spot. Night: 🌃 Riverside lights, dessert in town, and in deep winter maybe a glimpse of stars and dark skies.

ideas: 🌞 Bright riverside walks as ice and snow slowly melt on Kemijoki.
🚶 Forest paths at Ounasvaara getting easier to walk with patches of snow.
☕ Warm cafés with big windows to watch the changing season.
🕊 Returning birdlife near the riverbanks.
🌇 Late-evening light and almost no real darkness.
🍓 Fresh berries and berry desserts in cafés and markets.
🌿 Forest trails at Ounasvaara in green and soft sunlight.
🚣 Quiet boat or riverside moments by Kemijoki.
🍁 Orange and red forests around Ounasvaara hills.
🥧 Pastry cafés with cozy, warm interiors.
🎨 Arctic-themed art and exhibitions at Arktikum.
🌫 Misty river mornings with a magical atmosphere.
❄️ Thick snow on paths, roofs and trees almost everywhere.
🎄 Visits to Joulupukin Pajakylä (Santa Claus Village) exterior lights and decorations.
🍫 Hot chocolate and soups to warm up after walks.
✨ Clear nights with deep darkness and bright stars (and sometimes, with luck, northern lights far from city lights).

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Local buses connect the city center with Santa Claus Village, Arktikum and residential areas.
🚕 Taxis are common and useful in cold weather or late hours.
🚆 Trains and long-distance buses link Rovaniemi with southern Finland.
📱 Use 'Matkahuolto' and 'VR' (Finnish Railways) services to check regional routes and tickets.

city_events.name: Arctic Light Festival
city_events.description: ✨ Light shows and illuminated paths bringing color to the snowy darkness.

city_events.name: Rovaniemi Christmas Season
city_events.description: 🎄 Festive programs, markets and decorations around Santa Claus Village and the city center.

cities.name: Tampere
interests: Lakes 🌊 — Two big lakes with scenic shores and piers.
Parks 🌿 — Forested ridges, towers and viewpoints.
Urban Culture 🎭 — Red-brick factories, cafés and culture.
Local Food Exploration 😋 — Soups, baked goods and Nordic comfort dishes.
cities.local_food_tip: Look for veggie-friendly soups, potato dishes, pastries and Nordic breads — simple, filling and ideal for lakeside cities.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Start near Pyhäjärvi (Lake Pyhäjärvi) or Näsijärvi (Lake Näsijärvi) for a quiet lakeside walk. → 🏛️ Explore the exterior of the old red-brick industrial area around Finlaysonin alue (Finlayson Area) and Tammerkoski (Tammerkoski Rapids). → ☕ River café break. Afternoon: 🌿 Head to Pyynikinharju (Pyynikki Ridge Park) for forested trails. → 🗼 Visit the area around Pyynikin näkötorni (Pyynikki Observation Tower) and try a doughnut if you’d like. → 🍽️ Lunch: soups, salads or baked dishes in central Tampere. Sunset: 🌅 Lakeshore viewpoints or Pyynikki hills with warm evening colors over the water. Night: 🌃 Walk across river bridges with factory lights reflecting on Tammerkoski, then find a dessert spot in the center.

ideas: 🌼 Park flowers blooming near the lakes and Tammerkoski.
🚶 Walks along the lakeshores in cool but bright weather.
☕ Terraces near the rapids gradually filling with people.
🕊 Ducks, birds and early boat activity returning.
🌊 Swimming piers and sunbathing areas on Pyhäjärvi or Näsijärvi.
🍦 Ice cream breaks along the waterfront and in the center.
🌇 Warm evenings on Pyynikki hilltops watching pastel skies.
🎶 Outdoor events and small festivals in parks and squares.
🍁 Forest colors on Pyynikki and around lakeside paths.
🥧 Pastries and hot drinks in Tampere cafés.
🎨 Small galleries and museums in ex-factory buildings.
🌧 Cozy walks with umbrellas along Tammerkoski when it rains.
❄️ Snowy lakes and frozen shorelines (with care and local guidance).
🍫 Hot drinks after short, crisp walks.
✨ Lights on bridges and old red-brick buildings reflecting on ice or water.
🏔 Snow-covered Pyynikki trees looking like a winter forest.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 The Tampere tram (raitiotie) offers quick travel between main districts and the center.
🚌 Local buses reach neighborhoods, lakeshores and viewpoints further away.
🚆 Trains connect Tampere with other major Finnish cities, making it an easy base.
📱 Use the 'Nysse' app for public transport tickets, maps and timetables.

city_events.name: Tampere Theatre Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 One of the major Nordic theatre events, filling the city with performances and workshops.

city_events.name: Tampere Film Festival
city_events.description: 🎬 International short film festival attracting cinema lovers.

cities.name: Turku
interests: Riverside Walks 🌊 — Long promenades along the Aura River.
Medieval Landmarks 🏰 — Castle walls, old churches and historic squares.
Parks 🌿 — Green slopes and riverside lawns.
Local Food Exploration 😋 — Soups, rye bread, pastries and market snacks.
Urban Culture 🎭 — Student life, festivals and relaxed city corners.
cities.local_food_tip: Try warm soups, rye bread, veggie stews, fresh salads and pastries — simple but tasty, especially when enjoyed by the river.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Start with a walk along Aurajoki (Aura River): boats, bridges and riverside cafés. → 🏰 Continue downstream to view the exterior of Turun linna (Turku Castle): medieval stone walls and courtyards. → ☕ Riverside café stop nearby. Afternoon: 🏛️ Head back towards the center and explore Vanha Suurtori (Old Great Square) area with historic buildings. → ⛪ View Turun tuomiokirkko (Turku Cathedral) from outside. → 🍽️ Lunch: Nordic soups, salads and breads in a riverside or central restaurant. → 🌿 Relax in parks or grassy steps along Aurajoki. Sunset: 🌅 Aura River glowing with soft orange light, boats and reflections. Night: 🌃 Calm streets, student cafés and dessert spots near the river.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoms and greenery along Aurajoki embankments.
🚶 Riverside strolls in cool but sunny weather.
☕ Terrace cafés opening by the water.
🕊 Light boat traffic returning after winter.
🌊 Riverboats and floating terraces lining Aurajoki.
🍓 Fresh berries and snacks from local markets.
🌇 Long golden hours and late sunsets over the cathedral and river.
🎶 Summer festivals and outdoor events near the riverbanks.
🍁 Colorful trees along Aurajoki and near Turku Castle.
🥧 Warm cafés offering pastries and coffee.
🎨 Visits to museums by the river or in the old quarter.
🌧 Cozy umbrella walks on cooler, rainy days.
🎄 Lights and decorations around Vanha Suurtori (Old Great Square) and the cathedral.
🍫 Hot cocoa or glögi in small cafés.
❄ Snow along the riverbanks creating a quiet white corridor.
✨ Soft evening reflections of lights on water or ice.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Turku’s 'Föli' buses cover the city and nearby areas with simple flat fares.
🚲 The city is good for biking along the river and between districts.
🚆 Trains and long-distance buses connect Turku with Helsinki and inland towns.
📱 Use the 'Föli' app or website for route planning and ticket info.

city_events.name: Turun keskiaikaiset markkinat (Turku Medieval Market)
city_events.description: 🏰 Historic fair with costumes, crafts, performances and medieval atmosphere around the Old Great Square.

city_events.name: Turku Christmas City
city_events.description: 🎄 City-wide Christmas mood with lights, markets and cathedral events.
